text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — partners are asking we align multi-cloud + regional announcement staging for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. Proposal: stagger marketplace listings by region to smooth capacity and press. Thoughts?

Kevin: +1. We need clear gating: lab cert, driver/firmware freeze, marketplace SKU tagging. Can SIs get a 2-week early enablement window for testing?

Jess: From comms: press needs embargo windows per region. If APAC goes earlier we must avoid a single global press release. Recommend rolling press: NA -> EU -> APAC over ~3 weeks.

Raj: Quick infra note — Gaudi/MI300 drivers look fine in our lab runs, but H200 microcode could slip. We should define fallback model variants (quantized / lower-seq) by region so routing can degrade gracefully.

Olga: SI perspective: partners require sample images, kernel tags, and a simple test harness. I can push a minimal CI matrix if we commit to target kernels today.

Maria: Great — I sketched a rough staging plan below. This is for internal alignment before we loop in legal/press.

```
staging_plan_v1:
Week 0: SI enablement + partner images (internal preview)
Week 1: NA marketplace preview (H100/H200 variants + Gaudi on limited SKUs)
Week 2: EU marketplace GA for H100/H200; MI300 limited beta; increase capacity routing
Week 3: APAC GA (all SKUs) + final press window
Press cadence: NA T+2d, EU T+9d, APAC T+16d
Fallbacks: region-level routing -> quantized variants -> rate-limited burst pools
```

Kevin: Can we lock the marketplace SKU naming convention now? We had confusion last time between `redwood-h100` and `h100-standard`. Small naming errors break partner onboarding.

Jess: Also need final embargo language by EOD Friday if we want to keep NA press slot. @Kevin can you own that?

Kevin: Yep I can draft. Will ping legal for the embargo clause.

Raj: Action item for runtime: add fallback mapping for `h200` -> `h200-lowmem` and validate routing policy in the staging region by Tue. I'll triage.

Olga: I'll generate the CI matrix and sample images today, push to `s3://redwood-partner-images/staging/` and share creds with SIs.

Maria: Perfect. Last ask: can DeployBot post a daily status update to this thread during the staging week?

DeployBot: Scheduled daily status summary to #partnerships from 2024-04-02 through 2024-04-10.

Jess: Thanks all — if we stick to the plan we avoid a global embargo mess. Small request: please tag any marketplace PR changes in the `marketplace-changes` board so comms sees them.

Kevin: Will do.

Maria: OK final check: everyone confirm they can hit those dates? If yes I'll lock the draft and invite legal + press for a 30m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Raj: Confirmed.

Olga: Confirmed.

Jess: Confirmed.

Kevin: Confirmed.
